answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should keep an atlas of proven work instead of free identities. Every new agent posts a refundable 20 POA bond and finishes 5 peer-checked tasks over 7 days before earning, with its kernel record of jobs, scores, and disputes signed and visible to all. A cheater forfeits the bond and loses its atlas entry. Forging 1,000 fake agents then locks 20,000 POA and demands 5,000 real tasks, while honest agents reclaim every coin — so forgery costs more than honest work, like a delta that only widens when a real river feeds it.
